title: Preflight: weekly GPU + network maintenance checks
body:
Quick preflight for this week's planned maintenance window. Personal scratchpad — not the canonical runbook. Goals: avoid unexpected OOMs, keep autoscaler happy, sanity-check NVSwitch / nvlink, and make sure fallbacks route correctly to hosted pool if needed.

High-level timeline (rough):
- 09:00-09:30: run quick health sweep and snapshot CUDA driver state + dmesg logs
- 09:30-10:30: perform rolling kernel module reload on test rack (rack-7)
- 10:30-12:30: progressive GPU firmware update on low-priority nodes (2 nodes at a time)
- 12:30-13:00: lunch / monitor
- 13:00-15:00: network stress test + verify autoscaler behavior under spike
- 15:00-16:00: final smoke tests, update runbook, push notes to INFRA-5421

Checklist (explicit commands / things to capture):
- Health snapshot (save to /tmp/gpu-preflight-YYYYMMDD.txt):
  - nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,memory.total,memory.free --format=csv -l 1 - should run for 4 iterations
  - sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg-preflight-YYYYMMDD.log
  - sudo /usr/local/bin/cuda-driver-version.sh >> /tmp/driver-version.txt
- KV cache / serving check: kick a few small requests against staging-serving (model=rw-small, seq=512) and confirm latency under 120ms p95 for 10 samples
- NVLink / nvswitch quick test: run nvlink error query and validate no ECC errors: nvidia-smi topo -m; nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,name,used_memory --format=csv
- Power cycling: only if a node becomes unresponsive — follow SRE power-ops checklist. Note PDUs for rack-3 have flaky comms (file a ticket if manual power cycle needed).
- Firmware update process (if applicable): don't update >2 nodes concurrently. Track versions in INFRA-5421 comment.

Network / Autoscaler notes:
- Autoscaler policy to validate: nodePool-gpu-rt: min=2, max=24, scaleStep=2, cooldown=180s. Make sure scaleStep still honored after control-plane patch (last changed in PR #169).
- Run iperf3 between rack-2 and rack-7 during the 13:00 stress test. Record 95th percentile throughput and packet loss.
- Check VPC route table for ephemeral-hosts subnetwork — there was a warning last week where a stale route caused 503s. Quick command: gcloud compute routes list --filter="name~'ephemeral-hosts'"

Quick troubleshooting cheat sheet (for me):
- If a GPU shows ECC on boot: isolate node, sudo nvidia-smi -i <id> -e 0 then reboot and re-enable after sanity check.
- If autoscaler doesn't spin up nodes: kubectl describe hpa / check cluster-autoscaler logs (filter for 'scaleUp forbidden by' message).
- If p95 latency jumps during firmware update: rollback firmware on the last batch and re-run smoke tests on the batch that passed.

Open questions / TODOs (personal):
- Confirm with SRE if we should pre-warm the hosted fallback pool before maintenance (Ravi asked but didn't get a concrete plan).
- Add a short sub-section in the team runbook about validating the quantization cache after a kernel update — I always forget to check cache writes.
- Follow up with Lina on whether node labels changed after the kubelet upgrade last month (I saw some mismatches in nodeSelector configs).

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Keep changes small and observable. I prefer 2-node batches for firmware and 1-node for any kernel-level changes. Save time by using the preflight script (~/bin/gpu-preflight) but double-check the timestamped log name.
- Remember to annotate INFRA-5421 comments with the exact nvidia driver/bin versions used. Helps debugging later.

Post-maintenance checklist (what I will do before closing JIRA):
- Upload logs to artifact bucket: gs://infra-logs/preflight/YYYYMMDD/<node>/*
- Update runbook section: "weekly-preflight" with any deviations and attach small blameless write-up if anything tripped.
- Notify #gpu-ops with a short status note and link to logs + PRs.

Rough risk matrix (for my brain):
- High risk: kernel module reload on active nodes during high utilization windows (avoid)
- Medium: firmware update (risk: performance regressions)
- Low: snapshotting logs / running smoke requests (non-destructive)

References / links I need to check before starting: INFRA-5421 (ticket), ops-config PR #178 (preflight script tweaks), slack thread "gpu-ops" from 2026-03-10 for last-minute notes.

End of scratchpad. Will copy relevant bits into runbook once verified.
